## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the approval gate comparison before merging: a release with exactly the minimum number of approvals is now blocked, which goes against the gate's documented "at least" rule.

## Changes
The PR regenerates `aaa-generated/catalog.json`, renaming all 1,500 entries from `legacy-service-NNNN` (ports 10000+) to `production-service-NNNN` (ports 20000+), and adds a non-service key. It also changes `healthy` from `len(failures) == 0` to `not failures`, and the release gate from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` in the approval comparison — `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False` because `approvals > minimum` excludes the boundary, but the module docstring at line 1 says "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." The tests only check 3 and 1 approvals, so none of them hit the changed boundary. — Releases that have exactly the required number of approvals are blocked; at the default minimum of 2, that means every release with two approvals. — Fix: Revert to `approvals >= minimum` and add a boundary case `gate.approved(2, minimum=2)` to `test_approved_release` in `tests/test_release.py`.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the non-service `review_note` key from the catalog — The PR adds a top-level `"review_note"` entry whose value is a string, while every other entry is an object with `port` and `enabled`. Any loop over the catalog that reads `entry["port"]` raises `TypeError` on this key. It is also a hand edit to a generated file, so the next regeneration will drop it. — A consumer that loops over all catalog services would crash on this entry, and the generated output no longer matches its generator.

## Not reviewed
- This review read lines 2234–8959 of `../pr.diff` (the middle of the `aaa-generated/catalog.json` hunk) only through pattern counts: 3,000 key lines, 3,000 port lines, 1,500 `enabled` lines and 1,499 closing-brace lines, with all remaining lines read directly.
- The generator for `aaa-generated/catalog.json` is not in this repository, so this review could not check whether the new names and ports match its output.
